role: secondary thermal/radiant barrier on the outside face of the grounded metal hot shield

allowed: outside face of grounded metal hot shield
nonmoving cable thermal shield where released clearance remains satisfied
forbidden: as a substitute for grounded metal shielding

receipt_requirements: exact product/brand/lot or package identity evidence
manufacturer datasheet or package temperature rating evidence
adhesive chemistry/type recorded if specified; otherwise explicitly record NOT_SPECIFIED_BY_LISTING and retain mandatory S4 coupon qualification

coupon_smoke.representative_surface: scrap or representative metal shield material, not a heater/barrel/die wrap
acceptance: coupon is cut from the same physical roll intended for final installation
representative metal-shield adhesive interface reaches at least 180 C including U95 lower bound and never exceeds 190 C including U95 upper bound
hot dwell at qualification window is at least 600 s
no loss of adhesion that creates loose material

qualification_window.coupon_source: same physical 25 mm x 30 m roll intended for final installation

installed_p9_acceptance.criterion: adhesive-interface peak temperature + U95 <= 190 C, derived from 220 C conservative continuous design basis minus 30 C margin

note: Receipt or smoke PASS does not make TH-INS-01 a safety cutoff. TF-BARREL/TF-DIE and grounded metal shield remain independent requirements.

design_basis.basis: conservative lower bound of claimed long-term 220-280 C range
design_basis.adhesive_unknown_policy: adhesive chemistry is not inferred; S4 coupon smoke/adhesion evidence is mandatory before final installation
